decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis drop begins at index 710, with U recovering partially but incompletely by ~718, while N and E remain offset without definitive return within allowed context [670,729]. The absence of a clear opposing return on N/E prevents confirmation of a temporary offset; status is uncertain.
